<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="step-1"><nowiki>Step 1</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>1.1 Run the first code section by clicking the first play button</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/iSHbmxoSrX.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="step-2"><nowiki>Step 2</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>2.1. Scroll down to the second code section and edit the variables between the two lines of </nowiki><code><nowiki>#########</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/fCvNMZwNGs.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Notes:</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a. Check </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown</nowiki></span><nowiki> first for already created maps and variables sets to save you time</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎b. You can find map chunks by visiting </nowiki>[https://mejrs.github.io/ <nowiki>https://mejrs.github.io/</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Turn on the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>grid layer</nowiki></strong><nowiki> by hovering over the icon in the bottom-right</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ If you struggle to find a specific area the RS Wiki has a </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/RuneScape:Map/mapIDs <nowiki>page listing common locations</nowiki>]<nowiki> - simply replace the </nowiki><code><nowiki>-1</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎in the mej URL to the corresponding map ID</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>2.2. If unsure about the coloured tile markings, enter a number around where you think for player/cannon etc, then tweak and re-run the code</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>2.3. Choose how many tiles to trim off each side of the image (left,upper,right,bottom)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>2.4. Select which legend to use from the listed options</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>2.5. Remove the </nowiki><code><nowiki>#</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎from any lines you have set (any lines with a </nowiki><code><nowiki>#</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎will not be executed)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/88RSQ8Bnvb.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="real-example"><ins><nowiki>Real example</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="the-objective-make-a-player-position-map-for-the-new-osseous-afk-guide"><nowiki>The objective: make a player position map for the new Osseous AFK guide.</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>First we find the Rex Matriarch arena (we've had to scroll across Mej's map to find it):</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/4bOVcYUEIk.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Next, we add map gridlines on so we know which map chunks to reference:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/XwdQIAu7uv.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Now we want to reduce the map to just the Osseous arena (highlighted by the yellow box), which crosses multiple map chunks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/EJXkK2pB4r.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>First we set the x and y values to be of the top tile (63,153)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pre>mej_x = 63
mej_y = 153
</pre>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Next let's make it so 2 tiles are shown vertically</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pre>mej_height = 2
mej_width = 1
</pre>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>If we ran the code now, it would give us this:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/UDpjeF4nPZ.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Let's trim off the sides and press the run button to check our map:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pre>left = 1
upper = 43
right = 21
lower = 43
</pre>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/xb7wjGpZut.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>It's almost there! Let's cut off some of that excess map, put a coloured tile for the player position, and set the legend to show just 'player position':</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/A76Rk7HV0P.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Now let's hit the run button again... we did it!</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/Dys4yLDFqW.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
      
    </nowiki>
